fixed.summary: An element under a transform, or under a moved ancestor (a scrolling strip such as the compass's tape), is now cut by its ancestors' scrollers and overflow where it is drawn: one moved entirely outside its clipping box is no longer listed, one moved partly outside is `clipped`, and its box is where it shows on screen instead of where it was laid out. Each element inside a clipping ancestor carries `clip`, the screen rectangle (x, y, width, height) it is drawn cut to, so a reader can skip the parts of its `textLines` that are not drawn.
